slides.title: Entry into the city documented
slides.body: Conflict monitor ACLED documented Ethiopian government forces and Tigray Peace Force fighters entering Aksum.

slides.title: Border movements reported
slides.body: ACLED documented Ethiopian tanks and heavy weapons moving toward the Eritrean border, and Eritrean troops withdrawing through Zalambessa.

slides.title: Civilians in the middle
slides.body: A Zalambessa resident told AFP: "We are caught in the middle." The town had been without power or water for a week.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Restore services. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: AFP/Anadolu via Al Jazeera, "Ethiopian forces expand control in Tigray..." · Oct 15, 2026

card.title: Fighting reaches Aksum
card.body: ACLED documented government and Tigray Peace Force fighters entering the historic city.
